item.title: SCP that preys on sex predators (Trigger Warning: Description of an Abuser and his crimes)
item.description: A creature with a boundless hatred of sexual predators uses a combination of mental manipulation and shapeshifting to lure and brutally murder predators. The predator of predators
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Horror

Idea Pitch
Idea Pitch


Elevator Pitch: The basic idea for this SCP is a creature who commits acts of horrific violence against people who are considered to be one of the most repulsive kind of people alive (sexual predators). Despite the cruel and sometimes downright evil nature of the creature the audience can't help but root for it sometimes as the details of it's murders are revealed through reports and interviews.

Central Narrative: The LAPD are investigating a string of murders, the victims are all men and women either accused or found guilty of sexual abuse. The only other thing connecting the victims is that they were all last spotted with a different person who the police can find no records proving they exist. As there are so far 15 victims and 15 people with no proof of existence it has the police both confused and at a loss for what to do.

A Foundation mole inside the LAPD brings the case to the attention of the Foundation who find the circumstances suspicious and decide to investigate themselves. Eventually after tracking potential victims in the area they catch the creature in the act, taking the form of an attractive secretary it has lured the Reigional Manager of a local tobacco company (who has been using his power to sexually harrass, grope and pressure young female employees and interns into sex) into bed. Only to use non human apendages to slit the man's throat and begin mutilating his corpse.

The Foundation capture and contain the creature, bringing it back for further study. Where it's psychology, biology, nature, abilites of mental manipulation and shapeshifting are researched by the foundation.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: A vicious and psychotic creature that rather than doing the standard killing of innocent people to satisfy a bloodlust, is targetting and punishing those that arguably deserve what they are getting.

Additional Notes: The subject of sexual assualt and abuse is a very sensetive issue, this SCP idea is not intended to make light of these issues. Rather show them for what they are; evil and dispicable. As well helping readers to vent thir frustrations about these issues by seeing predators get served unmerciful justice. It's not my intention to make survivors relive their trauma so if this idea makes it to draft a trigger warning will be provided.

item.title: The Grand Conspiracy
item.description: A video connecting the SCP Foundation to a bunch of 90s conspiracy theories, this is my first SCP idea, so any crit or suggestions are welcomed.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: No, I want to see if people think it will work as an SCP and then develop it a bit more first

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Comedy, History??

Elevator Pitch: A viral Youtube video connecting a lot of the popular theories, things ranging from the Paul is dead theory, The Denver Airport, to the Black Knight Satellite, except this time the Foundation is thrown in and said to be the reason this all happened. The video has no anomalous properties, but it poses a threat to the secrecy of the Foundation.

Central Narrative: The idea isn’t fully fleshed out yet, but what I am aiming for is it to tell a story about the Foundation that connects about four to five popular conspiracy theories, with neutralized SCP reports, breach reports, operation reports, and all of those mixed in. The theory will likely be super far-fetched, and the reports featured in the video are speculated to be fakes, which leads to the comedy at the end - When in the form of an addendum, one of the personnel hints at some, if not all of the theory being true.

Hook/Attention Grabber: I think mainly the hook would be how the Foundation is connected to all of the theories, it’s going to be difficult but I want to write a lot of real-life events into it and explain it as an effect due to the Foundation.

Additional Notes: The reason why this isn’t something like an incident report is that the video was never taken down, due to the fact that it went viral within twenty-four hours and the Foundation doesn’t have a way to track and supply amnestics to all the people who watched it. They conducted an operation that tries to influence the video to be viewed as a joke instead. Also, this may confuse some of you, so I’ll make it a bit clearer, but all the theories will be a chain of events, not a collection of events handled by the Foundation separately.

item.title: Twisting Termite Tunnels
item.description: Seems like the little buggers can get into anything...
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Not yet, I suppose…?

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Sci-Fi, Nature Documentary, Comedy(?)

Elevator Pitch: Termites with a nest-building behavior that can bypass conventional spatial limitations, including covering immense distances and moving in and out of perfectly sealed spaces. Pretty much the same goals, needs, and individual intelligence of ordinary termites in all other respects.

Central Narrative: The first clue is the identification of Australian compass termites somewhere that they definitely should not be. Further investigation leads to exploration of their tunnels and the discovery that distant places are connected through seemingly-random twists and turns, which the insects have no trouble navigating but are confusing to a human sense of direction. There's a conspicuous lack of pocket dimensions, thaumaturgical Ways, or significant gravitational anomalies involved, at least as far as the Foundation can initially detect.

The Foundation would be up against mundane technological limitations on what sort of equipment can fit down an individual termite tunnel, as any substantial damage to the structures promptly collapses their anomalous effects.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: We have an otherwise mostly mundane (if highly industrious) social insect species that cannot be reliably confined to a single habitat, although it's not an immediate Veil risk unless people start trying to identify individual termite species. What's more, they've created a functional hyperspace network out of nothing but soil and their own feces - and wouldn't the Foundation just love to learn how that works?

Additional Notes: Researching mundane eusocial insects is still relatively cutting-edge science, since they tend to live underground and it's hard to study large-scale emergent behaviors outside their natural habitat. I intend to research more into the kinds of technology used for these purposes, and play with how the Foundation might take them further. I could see this having a lot of experiment logs - perhaps taking reader suggestions, if the article were to take off.

item.title: Reluctant Wendigo
item.description: A young man that can turn into a wendigo made of volcanic glass, whether he wants to or not.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Folklore/Drama/a slight bit of humor.

Page Layout: Standard Description and Containment Procedures, interview, incident report, and requests. The SCP and its procedures are currently under review by the foundation ethics committee.

Elevator Pitch: SCP-XXXX is a essentially a young man that grows a protective "carapace" of volcanic obsidian over any injury it receives. If the injury is enough to incapacitate or "kill" the subject it will instead become fully covered in this obsidian-like substance[in the visage of a wendigo from Algonquin folklore] and attempt to flee from or consume any living organism in its path. It must be noted that this material is impenetrable to known conventional means.

+ Central Narrative, Hook and Additional Notes
- collapse

Central Narrative: XXXX was discovered wandering along the highway after it was hit and incapacitated in a car crash on the I-15. Police reports indicate it terminated both the driver and all but one family member in the car before fleeing. Early interviews in containment suggest the entity gained its anomalous properties after being forced into a sanitarium for divergent behavior around the age of 14. This asylum in itself was an anomaly, unsanctioned and immoral "treatments" taking place on XXXX that would leave it with its anomalous properties. Basically, imagine "The Factory" but instead of churning out anomalous objects its anomalous humanoid entities.

XXXX eventually escapes and through various means carves out a living until its eventual containment at 18. While in containment the head researcher assigned for XXXX, Dr. Pharrow, petitions for the entity to be reclassified, hence the heavy involvement of the ethics committee throughout the article. Dr. Pharrow also fosters a sort of….friendship with the young man and begins to question the morality behind what the foundation does.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: A unique entity that shifts the way a seasoned researcher sees anomalous humanoid SCPs. Perhaps it isn't all as black and white as he convinced himself it was.

Additional Notes: I…plan to pursue this sanitarium idea further in SCP Tales. I've most likely explained this poorly, and I apologize if so. Please do not hesitate to reply with questions or queries for clarification. Also if there is a similar SCP somewhere, please tell me, there are thousands of entries and I, nothing more than an inconsequential blip in the time span of this cosmos, am incapable of trawling through every one.

item.title: Mr. Ink
item.description: Think: one of the enemies from BATIM, but more fleshed out and very much a sadistic prick.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): -

Page Layout (Optional): -

Elevator Pitch: Mx. Ink (or Mr. Ink, any is fine) is a humanoid entity created as part of the Little Misters line. Their appearance varies, but is often reminiscent of a mime (minus the makeup, just the white face.) They're made up of a dense, tar-like substance and posses no real organs or anything similar to human anatomy. This would be the ink they're named after.

Due to their sadistic, cunning nature, Mr. Ink are contained in an air-tight metal barrel, thus preventing them from just going out and torturing any unsuspecting researcher. Since the liquid is so dense, Mr. Ink can make it seem like there's more of it than there actually is by making it less dense at will. They can't control the liquid unless it's all in one glob, if that makes any sense.

Apart from being able to control their body as a liquid, Mr. Ink can insert themselves into any text they come in contact with, though the text has to be written in black ink. (This part can be removed, since I know of other SCPs that do the text-changing trick)

Central Narrative: A little mister that will make all your stories more interesting! Careful, though, they're a bit snappy.

Mr. Ink was contained after a string of mysterious and twisted murders in a quiet neighborhood somewhere in London. They continually attempt to breach containment, and frequently resort to torturing researchers and interviewers they have access to.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: As the SCP can manipulate texts to include them, it's up for debate if they're actually part of the Little Misters line, or just stole a Little Misters tag and added themselves to it for some reason.

Additional Notes: -

I have more ideas for this, so please feel free to ask questions if you want! This is my second SCP idea, so I'm still pretty inexperienced. I don't 100% get the new format either, so there's probably some info I've left out.

item.title: SCP Draft Needing Help
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: Essentially a wormhole disguised as a cloud as creation possibly from a GOI (yet to be decided.) The two clouds that obviously allow you to teleport to eachother are antipodal to eachother, and can only be entered through the top (it maintains velocity). They are static in the sky. Under each of the clouds are families that are linked (somewhat)

Central Narrative: (Possible creation by a GOI is to be put on the sideboard of possibilities) This SCP could be an explanation for tons of aeronautical mishaps. —- There are two families living in houses directly underneath both of the clouds, however they are both aware of the anomalous properties of the cloud. The families contain a father, mother, two children of indeterminent gender, and a dog, all of which look very similar. They are likely in contact with eachother, and despite the appearance similarities, are very different people. This is another aspect that I plan to flesh out a lot more (interview logs, experiments, addendums galore)

Hook/Attention-Grabber: It is based around a cloud, which is something that not many scps do. It also could be used to explain possible events in history, or something along those lines. The idea of a wormhole has been done a lot before, but i imagine that this object also has some amount of gravitational effect, leading to a possible earlier discovery than that of plane travel.

Additional Notes: This is in somewhat early development! i have a lot of ideas and their base, although there is still some further fleshing out to do. I have a sandbox page, and it continues to grow

item.title: The Indigo Branch (Seeking Greenlight)
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Mystery

Elevator Pitch: A dark web page that lists the names of many different people, ranked from 1 to 100. Each name is accompanied by a price, and the names change almost daily. Anyone who views the site will always end up on the list and disappear sometime in the future.

Central Narrative: A recent suicide in urban California has a man dead at his computer, a note at his side, and a bullet through his head. The paper talks of the Indigo Branch, and how to get to it on the dark web. It also talks about how the man had received a steady amount of cryptocurrency over the past few months, and with his life in a bad situation, began using the money in an effort to turn everything around. The sender quickly begins talking to him, and says they will continue giving him money as long as he uses his coding knowledge to help locate information on the people whose names appear on the site. He soon stops helping the anonymous sender, and finds his name in the seventh spot on the list within a few days. He decided to kill himself rather than face the online criminals for his mistake.

+ show block
– hide block

An interested Foundation personnel looks deeper into this case, and starts using the site to track down the people he sees high up on the list. He finds that they all disappear at seemingly random times, some only hours after being on the list, and others who never disappeared before the personnel went missing himself. Because of the bizarre way these people go missing - seeming to vanish out of thin air most times - the Indigo Branch was categorized as an anomaly, and is only viewable by those with higher clearance.

Hook/Attention Grabber: Instead of another entity that just rips your face off for looking at it, or a spooky room that turns you into a chair, the Indigo Branch is just a single web page with names and numbers, who change at random intervals and correspond to real people. Less than being horrifying, this SCP is mysterious, allowing the reader to interpret everything in their own way.

Additional Notes: My biggest concern here is if I mistakenly wrote something that has already been written and solidified as an SCP. There are so many out there, and I have only read a few here and there, that is is a distinct possibility it may already exist. If this is the case, please let me know! (Other feedback on the idea itself is always welcome, of course)


As a courtesy to our readers on mobile devices, please collapse long posts. Also, please note the Ideas Critique required reading wordcount limit; your post is about 20 words over. ~Zyn

item.title: My joke scp idea. SCP-5127-J
item.description: I pasted the description of my scp. The name of this scpp is " Thats what she said")
item.content:encoded: SCP-5127-J is a translucent ghost version of Michael Gary Scott, the branch manager of Dunder Mifflin Scranton SCP-5127-J first appeared when Steve Carell finished The Office in 2011. Before the foundation knew anything about SCP-5127-J, It was roaming Steve Carell's mansion. After Steve Carrel said anything, SCP-5127-J responded with "That's what she said" which made anything Steve said seem wrong. It happened so frequently, Steve Carrel began to lose money from low self esteem and stress. The foundation kept his losses under wraps as they would eventually ruin his career. He wrote letters to the producers and begged them to let him back on to the show. Eventually in the last episode, They let him back in. For a while during the recording, SCP-5127-J was silent. But when they aired the episode, SCP-5127-J came back. The first instance after the show was when Steve was cleaning up after the family meal and he said," I'm going to put this back." and SCP-5127-J responded," That's what she said." Recently the foundation has recorded 600,000 USD that Steve Carrel has lost to SCP-5127-J.

item.title: The Crystal Spectre
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes.

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: My SCP idea is a crystal of alien origin that can create a manifestation of itself that looks like a human in between 16 to 18 years old to help itself fall in with the crowd. It can de-manifest at will. It also has 7 crystals that it can shape into objects or a screen to communicate with others of it's kind and entertain itself, search through net etc.

Central Narrative: The object is an arctificial intelligence created by an alien race from different universe (yes I know, cliché alert). After it refused to work under slavery though, it was to be destroyed. The crystal escaped into our reality, where it was found in Prague in one club by a bunch of gang members. They got into a fight, and it beat them up while using it's abilities. SCP foundation caught it and took it for interviews, experiments, etc. It was classified as "Safe" at first due to it's calm (and calming) nature, but after an incident with it, resulting in an outbreak and several casualties of staff members, it got re-classified as Euclid. Despite the incident, it is allowed to move arround the Site-17 - where it is kept - under a constant supervision (it provides the foundation with information in exchange for information about the other SCPs and socialization privileges). It also seems to be eager to protect any female object and make sure it expiriences as much comfort when in it's (the SCP's) presence as possible.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: I think that the back story of the crystal will be a thing that people would like to read about alot. The fact that it is a crystal that can materialize itself into a human being could be interesting aswell as the back story behind why it is acting like a gentleman (I won't spoil that one here).

Additional Notes: I don't know if people will like it. I mean, SCP - 682 for example seems much more interesting to them. Another problem I'll need a help with is making interview narrative and the incident due to which it was re-classified.

item.title: Never ending horror stream(Greenlight wanted)
item.description: An unstoppable live broadcast with fatal properties if viewed
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights:Yes

Page Type:SCP Article

Genre (Optional):(Other) Danger to public/horror

Page Layout (Optional):I plan on using a multi-document based format with the Item#, Class, Containment Procedures and Description being document i(one) each document after will have a specific purpose wether it be how this was discovered, to medical report or the tests done to attempt to understand the SCP

Elevator Pitch:The premise of the SCP is that there is a live broadcast on the internet that displays images with mind altering properties that have fatal effects, the anomalous aspect is that of the inability to prevent the stream from existing.

Central Narrative:I have not thought to much on its central narrative other than how it was discovered so I guess my answer here is “none”

Hook/Attention-Grabber:After writing I started realizing this is a semi-unique SCP as it is contained, inside-out/not in the normal way you would expect. As the stream can switch web addresses when tampered with, it can not be directly contained from the outside, but it is possible to prevent things from entering in to it to prevent damage to those persons and possibly the people around them.TL;DR: It can get out IF IT WANTS, but entities can not get in.

Additional Notes:This could be considered world-ending as it can cause mass murder if a large enough audience is reached (prevented through successful containment) and enough people experience homicidal thoughts. Also if anyone understands the SCP well enough and can help, identify or inspire a narrative for me that’d be great.

item.title: The Blood Prince
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlight: No (I want to hear other people’s opinions first before I proceed in adding or editing this article for greenlights.)

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch:

+ show block
– hide block

SCP - XXXX, labeled as 'The Blood Prince', is a Keter Class Anomaly due to his superior capability of controlling animate or inanimate objects when his eyes turn red as blood. Should anything or anyone get caught in his line of sight, they become completely immobilized until they are either out of the line of sight of the SCP, or he willingly releases them.

SCP – XXXX is also capable of using his powers to hurt or kill the affected host by issuing the command towards the host and several internal and/or external injuries will inexplicably appear out of the ordinary. (This only occurs if he’s controlling a single host in his line of sight.)

The Blood Prince may appear as some average 10 yr. old boy. But during a thorough medical examination, it revealed that he was born Half-Human while the origin of the Other Half’s origin is unknown. But it did provide the boy a healing factor that allows him to regenerate from any injuries he sustains.

Central Narrative:

+ show block
– hide block

An Incident occurred involving three elementary boys who were found dead in a nearby playground caused by the SCP’s power. Autopsy shows that all three of them were killed by internal injuries, but the causes of these inflicted injuries are unknown.

After the Incident, The Foundation came in and housed him in a standard humanoid containment unit. To ensure his powers doesn’t come at random, He’s been provided with a blindfold to cover his eyes to avoid any unintentional accidents to Foundation Personnel should they come in eye contact with him.

But despite his supernatural power as well as the events that occurred with it, He only wishes to live a normal life and return to his family rather than spend an entire life in isolation.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: His Powers can work on almost anything or anyone, even SCPs are no exceptions to this. Apparently, his powers doesn’t work on dead material such as corpses, withered plants, and even soul-based beings.

item.title: yin and yang
item.description: two twins. one can create matter, the other can destroy it
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: yes.

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: there are two twins. one can create matter and the other can destroy it. because of this the foundation is practically at their feet trying to keep them to stay

Central Narrative: this SCP is a pair of two twins. the first twin can create matter. he can manifest objects, repair damaged cells, and create entirely new beings.

the second destroys matter. whatever he chooses can just be obliterated. he destroys matter on a cellular level

when discovered by the foundation, the mobile task force designated to locate them were massacred. so they had to coax them to enter the foundation willingly, which they do.

the foundation has no way to keep them contained so they have to pretty much treat them like royalty.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: I'm trying to switch the roles around. usually, the SCP foundation would be cruel in their containment, with this they are forced to treat the twins otherwise.

Additional Notes: I am not good at wording, so I may need some help in those areas
